newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher before budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher before budget.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Friday on strong demand for blue chips before the June 13 announcement of the 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said. The Karachi 100-share index rose 14.32 points, or 0.95 percent, to 1,520.58 amid 137 gainers and 93 losers. Dealers said the index was likely to open up after the Saturday-Sunday weekend.
Lever Brothers rose 10 rupees to 750, ICP SEMF 3.75 to 54, Brooke Bond 4.0 to 172, Engro 1.50 to 137.50 and PSO 1.25 to 321.25 at 12.20 p.m. (0720 GMT).
